title: Big Tech Layoffs Surge as AI Hiring Booms | Over 100,000 tech jobs lost in 2026 so far | N18G
description:
Over 100,000 tech workers have lost their jobs in 2026 so far, even as companies invest billions into artificial intelligence. From Meta and Microsoft to Oracle and Freshworks, firms are cutting roles while ramping up AI capabilities.
The shift is clear—fewer mid-level jobs, more demand for AI-skilled talent. Cognizant’s restructuring and hiring strategy highlights a deeper transition, especially for India’s IT workforce. While companies cite multiple reasons, the growing role of AI is reshaping hiring, wages and the future of work. Rachna Dhanrajani Reports.
